_note_model_path: RealVisXL V5.0 fp16 (approach A, openrail++, ungated) downloaded 2026-07-10 - see docs/GEN_MODELS.md. Loaded via AutoPipelineForText2Image.from_single_file. Approach B (base SDXL + splash LoRA) not yet staged; add if the by-eye spike shows the finetune is not painterly enough.
_note_controlnet: ControlNet-OpenPose SDXL (xinsir) for pose control. Pass --controlnet-pose <real splash> to extract a skeleton (natural pose + correct hand chirality) and keep sharp txt2img detail. Needs controlnet_aux (installed in .venv-gen).
_note_clip_model: MUST be the -quickgelu variant for the 'openai' pretrained weights: OpenAI CLIP was trained with QuickGELU activations. Plain 'ViT-L-14' + 'openai' warns 'QuickGELU mismatch' and degrades subject-QA accuracy (verified live 2026-07-10).
_note_resolution: MVP is 16:9 ONLY. Ultrawide/other aspects are deferred (a separate multi-target refactor); lw_gen_run refuses any non-16:9 aspect at exit 2.
_note_T_blur: T_blur is a NEW no-ref laplacian-variance floor (grayscale). Phase-2 calibration PLACEHOLDER - 100.0 is a seed value, re-calibrate on a real candidate sweep before trusting the blurry-reject gate.
_note_rc_live: Gate lists ONLY the VRAM-contending game/client processes. RiotClientServices.exe was REMOVED 2026-07-11: it is a background launcher service that lingers idle after the game closes and uses ~0 GPU, so gating on it would permanently block gen on any box with the Riot client installed (Vanguard vgtray/vgc are anti-cheat, never GPU, and are also excluded). Verified live: game closed + RiotClientServices resident -> nvidia-smi showed 554 MiB used / 11390 MiB free. The operator's locked hard-gate intent is VRAM contention by the actual game, which this list now matches. Future: a direct free-VRAM-threshold check would be a more robust gate.
